edition_title.en: WebSocket deadlocks are closed while TLS and exception logging settle
edition_title.fr: Les deadlocks WebSocket sont éliminés, TLS et les logs d’exception se stabilisent
edition_title.zh: WebSocket 死锁得到修复，TLS 与异常日志趋于稳定
edition_title.ru: Deadlock в WebSocket устранён, TLS и логирование исключений стабилизированы

intro.en: Async WebSocket broadcast and RTSP forwarding no longer send while holding a connection read lock, closing a deadlock when a failed write removes the peer. SChannel now treats orderly send-side shutdown as a closed connection and completes TLS 1.3 renegotiation coverage. Exception interception is also repaired across concurrent threads, Delphi Win32 and Delphi POSIX, while AVX-512 detection now verifies that the OS actually saves ZMM state.
intro.fr: Le broadcast WebSocket async et le forwarding RTSP n’envoient plus sous un read lock de connexion, supprimant un deadlock lorsqu’un échec d’écriture retire le peer. SChannel traite désormais une fermeture ordonnée pendant l’envoi comme une connexion close et complète la couverture de renégociation TLS 1.3. L’interception des exceptions est aussi corrigée entre threads, sous Delphi Win32 et Delphi POSIX, tandis que la détection AVX-512 vérifie que l’OS sauvegarde réellement l’état ZMM.
intro.zh: Async WebSocket 广播与 RTSP 转发不再持有连接 read lock 进行发送，从而修复写入失败并移除 peer 时的死锁。SChannel 现在把发送期间的正常关闭视为 closed connection，并补全 TLS 1.3 renegotiation 覆盖。异常拦截也修复了并发线程、Delphi Win32 与 Delphi POSIX 路径；AVX-512 检测则会确认 OS 确实保存 ZMM 状态。
intro.ru: Async WebSocket broadcast и RTSP forwarding больше не отправляют данные под connection read lock, устраняя deadlock при удалении peer после failed write. SChannel трактует корректное закрытие во время отправки как closed connection и завершает поддержку TLS 1.3 renegotiation. Исправлен перехват исключений между потоками, в Delphi Win32 и Delphi POSIX, а AVX-512 detection теперь проверяет сохранение ZMM state операционной системой.

en: TWebSocketAsyncServer.WebSocketBroadcast and TPostConnection.OnRead no longer deadlock when a failed send deletes a connection.
SChannel sends return nrClosed for graceful shutdown and its receive path handles TLS 1.3 SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE.
Concurrent exceptions are no longer lost, Delphi Win32 duplicate records are suppressed, and Delphi POSIX gains interception.
IntelAvx512 is now a startup-computed variable filtered through XCR0, with cpuAVX512 identifying OS-enabled x86-64-v4 support.
The Windows http.sys WebSocket regression test for issue #418 is disabled because it remains unreliable on Windows 11.
fr: TWebSocketAsyncServer.WebSocketBroadcast et TPostConnection.OnRead ne deadlockent plus lorsqu’un send défaillant supprime une connexion.
Les envois SChannel renvoient nrClosed lors d’une fermeture normale et la réception gère SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE sous TLS 1.3.
Les exceptions concurrentes ne disparaissent plus, les doublons Delphi Win32 sont supprimés et Delphi POSIX gagne l’interception.
IntelAvx512 devient une variable calculée au démarrage et filtrée par XCR0 ; cpuAVX512 identifie le support x86-64-v4 activé par l’OS.
Le test WebSocket http.sys Windows de l’issue #418 est désactivé car il reste instable sous Windows 11.
zh: TWebSocketAsyncServer.WebSocketBroadcast 与 TPostConnection.OnRead 在失败 send 删除连接时不再死锁。
SChannel 在正常关闭时返回 nrClosed，接收路径也会处理 TLS 1.3 的 SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE。
并发异常不再丢失，Delphi Win32 重复记录被抑制，Delphi POSIX 新增异常拦截。
IntelAvx512 现在是启动时计算并经 XCR0 过滤的变量；cpuAVX512 标识 OS 已启用的 x86-64-v4 支持。
issue #418 的 Windows http.sys WebSocket 回归测试因在 Windows 11 上仍不可靠而被禁用。
ru: TWebSocketAsyncServer.WebSocketBroadcast и TPostConnection.OnRead больше не deadlock при удалении соединения после failed send.
SChannel send возвращает nrClosed при корректном shutdown, а receive path обрабатывает TLS 1.3 SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE.
Concurrent exceptions больше не теряются, дубли Delphi Win32 подавлены, Delphi POSIX получил interception.
IntelAvx512 стал вычисляемой при запуске переменной с фильтром XCR0; cpuAVX512 обозначает включённый OS уровень x86-64-v4.
Windows http.sys WebSocket regression test для issue #418 отключён из-за нестабильности на Windows 11.

title.en: Async broadcasts stop upgrading a held read lock
title.fr: Les broadcasts async cessent d’upgrader un read lock détenu
title.zh: Async 广播不再升级已持有的 read lock
title.ru: Async broadcast больше не повышает удерживаемый read lock

summary.en: Broadcast and RTSP send paths snapshot live connections under the lock, then write outside it; dedicated snapshot methods and regression tests cover peers that reset during a send.
summary.fr: Les chemins broadcast et RTSP copient les connexions actives sous lock puis écrivent hors lock ; des méthodes de snapshot et tests couvrent les peers réinitialisés pendant un send.
summary.zh: 广播与 RTSP 发送路径在锁内取得活动连接快照，再于锁外写入；新增快照方法与回归测试覆盖发送期间 reset 的 peer。
summary.ru: Broadcast и RTSP paths получают snapshot живых соединений под lock, затем пишут вне него; новые snapshot methods и regression tests покрывают reset peer во время send.

title.en: SChannel closure and TLS 1.3 key updates are normalized
title.fr: La fermeture SChannel et les key updates TLS 1.3 sont normalisées
title.zh: SChannel 关闭与 TLS 1.3 key update 得到统一处理
title.ru: Закрытие SChannel и TLS 1.3 key update нормализованы

summary.en: Windows socket closure codes map to nrClosed, graceful zero-byte sends stop raising, SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE continues the handshake, and the optional OpenSSL SSL_key_update wrapper drives cross-backend tests.
summary.fr: Les codes de fermeture Windows deviennent nrClosed, les sends nuls normaux ne lèvent plus d’exception, SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE poursuit le handshake et le wrapper OpenSSL SSL_key_update alimente les tests croisés.
summary.zh: Windows socket 关闭码映射为 nrClosed，正常零字节 send 不再抛异常，SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE 会继续 handshake，可选 OpenSSL SSL_key_update wrapper 用于跨 backend 测试。
summary.ru: Windows closure codes переводятся в nrClosed, корректный zero-byte send не вызывает exception, SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE продолжает handshake, а optional OpenSSL SSL_key_update используется в cross-backend tests.

title.en: Exception interception becomes concurrent and cross-platform
title.fr: L’interception des exceptions devient concurrente et multiplateforme
title.zh: 异常拦截支持并发与跨平台
title.ru: Перехват исключений стал конкурентным и кроссплатформенным

summary.en: The global callback stays installed during nested logging, modern Delphi routes through RaiseExceptObjProc, POSIX is enabled where supported, and zero addresses no longer produce malformed log text.
summary.fr: Le callback global reste installé pendant les logs imbriqués, Delphi moderne passe par RaiseExceptObjProc, POSIX est activé quand disponible et les adresses nulles ne déforment plus le log.
summary.zh: 嵌套日志期间全局 callback 保持安装，现代 Delphi 通过 RaiseExceptObjProc 路由，支持的平台启用 POSIX，零地址不再生成错误日志文本。
summary.ru: Global callback остаётся установленным при nested logging, современный Delphi использует RaiseExceptObjProc, POSIX включается при поддержке, а нулевые адреса не портят текст лога.

title.en: AVX-512 dispatch now checks OS state
title.fr: Le dispatch AVX-512 vérifie désormais l’état de l’OS
title.zh: AVX-512 调度现在检查 OS 状态
title.ru: AVX-512 dispatch теперь проверяет состояние OS

summary.en: CPUID feature bits are filtered through XGETBV once at startup, preventing EVEX execution where a VM or old OS does not preserve opmask and ZMM registers.
summary.fr: Les bits CPUID sont filtrés une fois au démarrage via XGETBV, évitant l’exécution EVEX lorsqu’une VM ou un ancien OS ne préserve pas les registres opmask et ZMM.
summary.zh: CPUID 特性位会在启动时通过 XGETBV 过滤一次，避免在 VM 或旧 OS 不保存 opmask 与 ZMM 寄存器时执行 EVEX。
summary.ru: CPUID flags один раз фильтруются через XGETBV при запуске, предотвращая EVEX execution, если VM или старый OS не сохраняет opmask/ZMM registers.

order.why: Take the broadcast deadlock repair, safe connection snapshots and their final synchronization tests together.
Take the TLS key-update coverage with the SChannel renegotiation and graceful-close fixes.
Take the full exception-interception series because later commits refine platform routing and compile guards.
Take both tunnel shutdown commits so fClosed is published while the send lock is still held.
Take AVX-512 OS-state detection with the startup precomputation refinement.

upgrade_advice.en: Land on build 2.4.17324. Upgrade promptly if production uses TWebSocketAsyncServer.WebSocketBroadcast, RTSP-over-HTTP forwarding, Windows SChannel, TTunnelLocal or relies on complete exception logs under concurrency. Stress broadcasts while clients reset, TLS 1.3 key updates and peer shutdown, and tunnel close during WaitForHandshake. The raw payload has no superseded_by markers, so no formal avoid window is asserted; take each ordered sequence whole. Keep a separate eye on issue #418 because its Windows http.sys WebSocket test is disabled.
upgrade_advice.fr: Visez la build 2.4.17324. Mettez à niveau si la production utilise TWebSocketAsyncServer.WebSocketBroadcast, le forwarding RTSP-over-HTTP, SChannel Windows, TTunnelLocal ou dépend de logs d’exception complets sous concurrence. Stressez les broadcasts avec reset client, les key updates TLS 1.3, la fermeture du peer et ClosePort pendant WaitForHandshake. Aucun superseded_by n’étaye une plage à éviter ; prenez chaque série entière. Surveillez séparément l’issue #418 dont le test WebSocket http.sys Windows est désactivé.
upgrade_advice.zh: 请采用 build 2.4.17324。若生产环境使用 TWebSocketAsyncServer.WebSocketBroadcast、RTSP-over-HTTP 转发、Windows SChannel、TTunnelLocal，或依赖并发下完整异常日志，应尽快升级。请压力测试客户端 reset 时的广播、TLS 1.3 key update、peer 关闭，以及 WaitForHandshake 期间的 ClosePort。原始 payload 没有 superseded_by，因此不声明正式避开区间；请完整采用每组序列。issue #418 的 Windows http.sys WebSocket 测试已禁用，需要单独关注。
upgrade_advice.ru: Переходите на build 2.4.17324. Срочно обновитесь при использовании TWebSocketAsyncServer.WebSocketBroadcast, RTSP-over-HTTP forwarding, Windows SChannel, TTunnelLocal или при зависимости от полных exception logs под нагрузкой. Проверьте broadcast при reset clients, TLS 1.3 key update, peer shutdown и ClosePort во время WaitForHandshake. superseded_by отсутствует, поэтому формальный avoid range не заявляется; берите серии целиком. Отдельно следите за issue #418: Windows http.sys WebSocket test отключён.

notes.en: Reviewed all 27 non-merge commits from build 2.4.17294 through 2.4.17324: 779 additions and 316 deletions after excluding version bookkeeping. Three merge commits were excluded. The exact upstream head was inspected. No commit carries superseded_by metadata; ordering reflects directly inspected follow-ups without asserting an avoid range.
notes.fr: Les 27 commits non-merge de 2.4.17294 à 2.4.17324 ont été examinés : 779 ajouts et 316 suppressions hors version bookkeeping. Trois merges sont exclus. Le head upstream exact a été inspecté. Aucun superseded_by ; l’ordre vient des follow-ups inspectés sans plage à éviter.
notes.zh: 已审查 build 2.4.17294 至 2.4.17324 的全部 27 个 non-merge commit：排除版本 bookkeeping 后新增 779 行、删除 316 行。另有 3 个 merge commit 被排除。已检查精确 upstream head。没有 superseded_by；顺序来自直接检查的 follow-up，不声明避开区间。
notes.ru: Проверены все 27 non-merge commits от 2.4.17294 до 2.4.17324: 779 добавлений и 316 удалений без version bookkeeping. Три merge commits исключены. Проверен точный upstream head. superseded_by отсутствует; порядок основан на проверенных follow-ups без avoid range.

headline.en: The Windows http.sys WebSocket regression test is temporarily disabled
headline.fr: Le test WebSocket http.sys Windows est temporairement désactivé
headline.zh: Windows http.sys WebSocket 回归测试暂时禁用
headline.ru: Windows http.sys WebSocket regression test временно отключён

what_changed.en: TNetworkProtocols._HttpApiWebSocketServer now exits immediately, disabling issue #418 coverage because the test is reported unreliable, especially on Windows 11.
what_changed.fr: TNetworkProtocols._HttpApiWebSocketServer quitte immédiatement, désactivant la couverture de l’issue #418 car le test est jugé instable, surtout sous Windows 11.
what_changed.zh: TNetworkProtocols._HttpApiWebSocketServer 现在立即退出，禁用 issue #418 覆盖，因为该测试据称不可靠，尤其在 Windows 11 上。
what_changed.ru: TNetworkProtocols._HttpApiWebSocketServer теперь сразу выходит, отключая покрытие issue #418 из-за нестабильности теста, особенно на Windows 11.

impact.en: Application behavior is unchanged, but CI no longer detects regressions in this Windows http.sys WebSocket scenario.
impact.fr: Le comportement applicatif ne change pas, mais la CI ne détecte plus les régressions de ce scénario WebSocket http.sys Windows.
impact.zh: 应用行为不变，但 CI 不再检测此 Windows http.sys WebSocket 场景的回归。
impact.ru: Application behavior не меняется, но CI больше не обнаруживает regressions в этом Windows http.sys WebSocket scenario.

headline.en: WebSocket broadcast stress testing starts only after the first client connects
headline.fr: Le stress test de broadcast WebSocket démarre après la première connexion
headline.zh: WebSocket 广播压力测试在首个客户端连接后才启动
headline.ru: WebSocket broadcast stress test запускается после первого клиента

what_changed.en: The broadcast regression thread starts after the first successful client connection, alternates zero and 50 ms sends, records its local sent count and avoids dereferencing that count if shutdown wedges.
what_changed.fr: Le thread de régression démarre après la première connexion réussie, alterne les sends à 0 et 50 ms, conserve un compteur local et évite de le déréférencer si le shutdown se bloque.
what_changed.zh: 广播回归线程在首个客户端成功连接后启动，交替使用 0 与 50 ms send，保存本地发送计数，并在 shutdown 卡死时避免解引用该计数。
what_changed.ru: Regression thread стартует после первого успешного client connection, чередует send с 0 и 50 ms, хранит локальный счётчик и не разыменовывает его при wedged shutdown.

impact.en: Only the regression harness changes; production Delphi/FPC code and APIs are unaffected.
impact.fr: Seul le harnais de régression change ; le code et les API Delphi/FPC de production ne changent pas.
impact.zh: 仅回归测试 harness 改变；生产 Delphi/FPC 代码与 API 不受影响。
impact.ru: Меняется только regression harness; production code и API Delphi/FPC не затронуты.

headline.en: A graceful SChannel send-side close now returns nrClosed
headline.fr: Une fermeture SChannel normale pendant l’envoi renvoie désormais nrClosed
headline.zh: SChannel 发送侧正常关闭现在返回 nrClosed
headline.ru: Корректное закрытие SChannel при send теперь возвращает nrClosed

what_changed.en: TSChannelNetTls.SendRawAll initializes the result as nrClosed before examining a zero-byte send, so an orderly peer shutdown exits instead of raising ESChannel.
what_changed.fr: TSChannelNetTls.SendRawAll initialise le résultat à nrClosed avant de traiter un send nul, afin qu’une fermeture ordonnée sorte sans lever ESChannel.
what_changed.zh: TSChannelNetTls.SendRawAll 在检查零字节 send 前把结果设为 nrClosed，使 peer 正常关闭时直接退出而不抛出 ESChannel。
what_changed.ru: TSChannelNetTls.SendRawAll задаёт nrClosed до обработки zero-byte send, поэтому корректный peer shutdown завершает вызов без ESChannel.

impact.en: Windows TLS clients and servers can close during a pending send without converting normal shutdown into an exception.
impact.fr: Les clients et serveurs TLS Windows peuvent fermer pendant un send en attente sans transformer un shutdown normal en exception.
impact.zh: Windows TLS 客户端与服务器可在 send 挂起时关闭，而不会把正常 shutdown 转成异常。
impact.ru: Windows TLS clients и servers могут закрываться во время pending send без превращения normal shutdown в exception.

action_detail.en: Upgrade and test peer shutdown while large SChannel responses or requests are still being sent.
action_detail.fr: Mettez à niveau et testez le shutdown du peer pendant l’envoi de grandes requêtes ou réponses SChannel.
action_detail.zh: 升级并测试大型 SChannel 请求或响应仍在发送时的 peer shutdown。
action_detail.ru: Обновитесь и проверьте peer shutdown во время отправки больших SChannel requests/responses.

headline.en: The broadcast regression alternates blocking and non-blocking sends
headline.fr: La régression broadcast alterne sends bloquants et non bloquants
headline.zh: 广播回归测试交替执行阻塞与非阻塞 send
headline.ru: Broadcast regression чередует blocking и non-blocking send

what_changed.en: The WebSocket regression test moves the sent counter out of the worker object and alternates aTimeOut between zero and 50 ms while repeatedly connecting and resetting clients.
what_changed.fr: Le test WebSocket déplace le compteur hors du worker et alterne aTimeOut entre zéro et 50 ms pendant les connexions et resets répétés.
what_changed.zh: WebSocket 回归测试把发送计数移出 worker 对象，并在反复连接和 reset 客户端时让 aTimeOut 在 0 与 50 ms 间切换。
what_changed.ru: WebSocket regression test выносит sent counter из worker и чередует aTimeOut 0/50 ms при повторных connect/reset clients.

impact.en: Coverage now exercises both WebSocketBroadcast connection-snapshot paths; application behavior is unchanged.
impact.fr: La couverture exerce les deux chemins de snapshot de WebSocketBroadcast ; le comportement applicatif ne change pas.
impact.zh: 测试现在覆盖 WebSocketBroadcast 的两条连接快照路径；应用行为不变。
impact.ru: Coverage проверяет оба connection-snapshot path WebSocketBroadcast; application behavior не меняется.

headline.en: SChannel socket closure is reported without shutdown exceptions
headline.fr: La fermeture socket SChannel est signalée sans exception de shutdown
headline.zh: SChannel socket 关闭不再产生 shutdown 异常
headline.ru: Закрытие SChannel socket сообщается без shutdown exceptions

what_changed.en: NetErrorFromSystem maps WSAENOTCONN and WSAESHUTDOWN to nrClosed. TSChannelNetTls.SendRawAll returns TNetResult, callers stop when the socket closes, and receive errors include the normalized result and Windows message.
what_changed.fr: NetErrorFromSystem mappe WSAENOTCONN et WSAESHUTDOWN vers nrClosed. TSChannelNetTls.SendRawAll renvoie TNetResult, les appelants s’arrêtent à la fermeture et les erreurs receive incluent le résultat normalisé.
what_changed.zh: NetErrorFromSystem 将 WSAENOTCONN 与 WSAESHUTDOWN 映射为 nrClosed。TSChannelNetTls.SendRawAll 返回 TNetResult，socket 关闭时调用方停止，receive 错误包含标准化结果与 Windows 信息。
what_changed.ru: NetErrorFromSystem переводит WSAENOTCONN и WSAESHUTDOWN в nrClosed. TSChannelNetTls.SendRawAll возвращает TNetResult, callers останавливаются при закрытии, receive errors включают нормализованный результат.

impact.en: Normal Windows TLS teardown no longer appears as a fatal ESChannel path, including during handshake-token or encrypted-output sending.
impact.fr: Le teardown TLS Windows normal n’apparaît plus comme une erreur ESChannel fatale, y compris pendant l’envoi de tokens de handshake ou de sortie chiffrée.
impact.zh: 正常 Windows TLS teardown 不再表现为致命 ESChannel，包括发送 handshake token 或加密输出时。
impact.ru: Нормальный Windows TLS teardown больше не выглядит как fatal ESChannel, включая отправку handshake tokens и encrypted output.

action_detail.en: Retest client disconnects during SChannel handshake, large writes and server shutdown.
action_detail.fr: Retestez les déconnexions client pendant le handshake SChannel, les grandes écritures et le shutdown serveur.
action_detail.zh: 重测 SChannel handshake、大型写入与服务器 shutdown 期间的客户端断开。
action_detail.ru: Перепроверьте client disconnect во время SChannel handshake, больших writes и server shutdown.

headline.en: SChannel continues the handshake on TLS 1.3 key updates
headline.fr: SChannel poursuit le handshake lors des key updates TLS 1.3
headline.zh: SChannel 在 TLS 1.3 key update 时继续 handshake
headline.ru: SChannel продолжает handshake при TLS 1.3 key update

what_changed.en: TSChannelNetTls.Receive recognizes SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE and feeds remaining input back into HandshakeStep. The test client can request SSL_key_update mid-transfer, and TBuffer32K is added for the expanded TLS test paths.
what_changed.fr: TSChannelNetTls.Receive reconnaît SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE et renvoie l’entrée restante à HandshakeStep. Le client de test peut demander SSL_key_update en cours de transfert et TBuffer32K est ajouté.
what_changed.zh: TSChannelNetTls.Receive 识别 SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE，并把剩余输入重新交给 HandshakeStep。测试客户端可在传输中请求 SSL_key_update，同时新增 TBuffer32K。
what_changed.ru: TSChannelNetTls.Receive распознаёт SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE и передаёт остаток input в HandshakeStep. Test client может запросить SSL_key_update в середине передачи; добавлен TBuffer32K.

impact.en: Long-lived SChannel TLS 1.3 connections survive peer key updates instead of failing after DecryptMessage requests renegotiation.
impact.fr: Les connexions SChannel TLS 1.3 longues survivent aux key updates du peer au lieu d’échouer après SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE.
impact.zh: 长期 SChannel TLS 1.3 连接可在 peer key update 后继续工作，不再因 DecryptMessage 请求 renegotiation 而失败。
impact.ru: Долгоживущие SChannel TLS 1.3 connections переживают peer key update вместо сбоя после SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE.

action_detail.en: Exercise long-lived TLS 1.3 transfers and a peer-initiated key update on Windows 11.
action_detail.fr: Testez les transferts TLS 1.3 longs et un key update initié par le peer sous Windows 11.
action_detail.zh: 在 Windows 11 上测试长期 TLS 1.3 传输及 peer 发起的 key update。
action_detail.ru: Проверьте долгие TLS 1.3 transfers и peer-initiated key update на Windows 11.

headline.en: mTLS tests stream large request bodies across many TLS records
headline.fr: Les tests mTLS diffusent de grands bodies sur de nombreux records TLS
headline.zh: mTLS 测试跨多个 TLS record 发送大型请求体
headline.ru: mTLS tests передают большие request bodies через множество TLS records

what_changed.en: test.net.proto adds a large POST route, chunked client sends, CRC32C verification and TLS 1.2/TLS 1.3 cases for SChannel and OpenSSL servers.
what_changed.fr: test.net.proto ajoute une route POST volumineuse, des envois client par chunks, une vérification CRC32C et des cas TLS 1.2/1.3 pour SChannel et OpenSSL.
what_changed.zh: test.net.proto 新增大型 POST 路由、分块客户端发送、CRC32C 校验，以及 SChannel/OpenSSL 服务器的 TLS 1.2 与 TLS 1.3 场景。
what_changed.ru: test.net.proto добавляет large POST route, chunked client sends, CRC32C verification и TLS 1.2/1.3 cases для SChannel/OpenSSL servers.

impact.en: Regression coverage now spans record boundaries and large mTLS payloads; no application API changes.
impact.fr: La couverture traverse désormais les limites de records et les gros payloads mTLS ; aucune API applicative ne change.
impact.zh: 回归覆盖现包含跨 record 边界与大型 mTLS payload；应用 API 不变。
impact.ru: Regression coverage охватывает границы records и большие mTLS payloads; application API не меняется.

headline.en: The OpenSSL wrapper exposes TLS 1.3 key updates
headline.fr: Le wrapper OpenSSL expose les key updates TLS 1.3
headline.zh: OpenSSL wrapper 公开 TLS 1.3 key update
headline.ru: OpenSSL wrapper предоставляет TLS 1.3 key update

what_changed.en: mormot.lib.openssl11 adds SSL_KEY_UPDATE_NOT_REQUESTED, SSL_KEY_UPDATE_REQUESTED and the optional SSL_key_update function to dynamic and static OpenSSL bindings.
what_changed.fr: mormot.lib.openssl11 ajoute SSL_KEY_UPDATE_NOT_REQUESTED, SSL_KEY_UPDATE_REQUESTED et la fonction optionnelle SSL_key_update aux bindings dynamiques et statiques.
what_changed.zh: mormot.lib.openssl11 在动态与静态 OpenSSL binding 中新增 SSL_KEY_UPDATE_NOT_REQUESTED、SSL_KEY_UPDATE_REQUESTED 与可选 SSL_key_update 函数。
what_changed.ru: mormot.lib.openssl11 добавляет SSL_KEY_UPDATE_NOT_REQUESTED, SSL_KEY_UPDATE_REQUESTED и optional SSL_key_update в dynamic/static bindings.

impact.en: Low-level OpenSSL users can request a TLS 1.3 traffic-key rotation. Older OpenSSL libraries keep loading because the symbol is optional.
impact.fr: Les utilisateurs OpenSSL bas niveau peuvent demander une rotation de clé TLS 1.3. Les anciennes bibliothèques continuent de charger car le symbole est optionnel.
impact.zh: 低层 OpenSSL 使用方可请求 TLS 1.3 traffic-key 轮换；旧版 OpenSSL 因该符号为可选仍可加载。
impact.ru: Низкоуровневые OpenSSL users могут запросить TLS 1.3 traffic-key rotation. Старые библиотеки продолжают загружаться, поскольку symbol optional.

headline.en: LDAP and WebSocket comments are clarified without runtime changes
headline.fr: Les commentaires LDAP et WebSocket sont clarifiés sans changement runtime
headline.zh: LDAP 与 WebSocket 注释得到澄清，运行时不变
headline.ru: Комментарии LDAP и WebSocket уточнены без runtime changes

what_changed.en: Comments around CldapBroadcast, AVX-512 globals and WebSocket client-ID sorting are corrected or clarified; executable statements remain unchanged.
what_changed.fr: Les commentaires autour de CldapBroadcast, des globals AVX-512 et du tri des IDs WebSocket sont corrigés ; les instructions exécutables ne changent pas.
what_changed.zh: CldapBroadcast、AVX-512 global 与 WebSocket client-ID 排序附近的注释得到修正或澄清；可执行语句不变。
what_changed.ru: Исправлены комментарии около CldapBroadcast, AVX-512 globals и сортировки WebSocket IDs; executable statements не меняются.

impact.en: No impact on Delphi/FPC application code or runtime behavior.
impact.fr: Aucun impact sur le code applicatif Delphi/FPC ni sur le comportement runtime.
impact.zh: 对 Delphi/FPC 应用代码与运行时行为没有影响。
impact.ru: Нет влияния на Delphi/FPC application code или runtime behavior.

headline.en: The WebSocket deadlock regression joins the multithread suite
headline.fr: La régression du deadlock WebSocket rejoint la suite multithread
headline.zh: WebSocket 死锁回归测试加入多线程套件
headline.ru: WebSocket deadlock regression включён в multithread suite

what_changed.en: The issue #629 regression is moved into SlowTests, uses TLoggedThread and runs with the other background network tests when /multithread is enabled.
what_changed.fr: La régression de l’issue #629 passe dans SlowTests, utilise TLoggedThread et tourne avec les autres tests réseau en arrière-plan sous /multithread.
what_changed.zh: issue #629 回归测试移入 SlowTests，改用 TLoggedThread，并在启用 /multithread 时与其他后台网络测试一起运行。
what_changed.ru: Regression issue #629 перенесена в SlowTests, использует TLoggedThread и запускается с другими background network tests при /multithread.

impact.en: Only test scheduling and diagnostics change; production code is unaffected.
impact.fr: Seuls l’ordonnancement des tests et les diagnostics changent ; le code de production n’est pas concerné.
impact.zh: 仅测试调度与诊断改变；生产代码不受影响。
impact.ru: Меняются только test scheduling и diagnostics; production code не затронут.

headline.en: WebSocket broadcasts use safe snapshots for both timeout modes
headline.fr: Les broadcasts WebSocket utilisent des snapshots sûrs pour les deux modes de timeout
headline.zh: WebSocket 广播在两种 timeout 模式下使用安全快照
headline.ru: WebSocket broadcast использует безопасные snapshots для обоих timeout modes

what_changed.en: GetConnectionHandles and GetConnectionInstances iterate the actual class-reference array. WebSocketBroadcast uses instance snapshots only for timeout zero, handle lookup for blocking sends, and checks ConnectionFind for nil before SendDirect.
what_changed.fr: GetConnectionHandles et GetConnectionInstances parcourent le vrai tableau de références. WebSocketBroadcast utilise les instances avec timeout zéro, les handles pour les sends bloquants et vérifie ConnectionFind avant SendDirect.
what_changed.zh: GetConnectionHandles 与 GetConnectionInstances 直接遍历类引用数组。WebSocketBroadcast 仅在 timeout 为零时使用 instance 快照，阻塞发送使用 handle lookup，并在 SendDirect 前检查 ConnectionFind 是否为 nil。
what_changed.ru: GetConnectionHandles/GetConnectionInstances обходят реальный массив class references. WebSocketBroadcast использует instance snapshots только при timeout 0, handles для blocking send и проверяет ConnectionFind на nil.

impact.en: Broadcasting to peers that close concurrently no longer risks deadlock or a nil dereference, while non-blocking broadcasts avoid repeated searches.
impact.fr: Le broadcast vers des peers fermés concurremment ne risque plus deadlock ni nil dereference, et les broadcasts non bloquants évitent les recherches répétées.
impact.zh: 向并发关闭的 peer 广播不再有死锁或 nil dereference 风险；非阻塞广播也避免重复搜索。
impact.ru: Broadcast к конкурентно закрывающимся peers больше не рискует deadlock или nil dereference, а non-blocking path избегает повторных searches.

action_detail.en: Upgrade and stress both aTimeOut=0 and non-zero broadcasts while clients reset or disconnect.
action_detail.fr: Mettez à niveau et stressez les broadcasts avec aTimeOut nul et non nul pendant les resets ou déconnexions clients.
action_detail.zh: 升级并在客户端 reset 或断开时压力测试 aTimeOut=0 与非零广播。
action_detail.ru: Обновитесь и нагрузочно проверьте broadcast с aTimeOut=0 и ненулевым при reset/disconnect clients.

headline.en: Async connection owners can snapshot live handles or instances
headline.fr: Les owners async peuvent capturer les handles ou instances actifs
headline.zh: Async 连接 owner 可取得活动 handle 或 instance 快照
headline.ru: Async connection owners могут получать snapshot живых handles или instances

what_changed.en: TAsyncConnections adds public GetConnectionHandles and GetConnectionInstances methods that copy non-closed connections while holding ConnectionLock.ReadOnlyLock.
what_changed.fr: TAsyncConnections ajoute les méthodes publiques GetConnectionHandles et GetConnectionInstances, qui copient les connexions non fermées sous ConnectionLock.ReadOnlyLock.
what_changed.zh: TAsyncConnections 新增公开 GetConnectionHandles 与 GetConnectionInstances，在持有 ConnectionLock.ReadOnlyLock 时复制未关闭连接。
what_changed.ru: TAsyncConnections добавляет public methods GetConnectionHandles/GetConnectionInstances, копирующие незакрытые соединения под ConnectionLock.ReadOnlyLock.

impact.en: Custom async code gains safer snapshot APIs. Instance snapshots are only protected from recycling for KeepConnectionInstanceMS and must not be used for blocking work.
impact.fr: Le code async personnalisé gagne des API de snapshot plus sûres. Les instances ne sont protégées du recyclage que pendant KeepConnectionInstanceMS et ne conviennent pas au travail bloquant.
impact.zh: 自定义 async 代码获得更安全的快照 API；instance 快照仅在 KeepConnectionInstanceMS 内避免回收，不应执行阻塞操作。
impact.ru: Custom async code получает более безопасные snapshot APIs. Instances защищены от recycling только на KeepConnectionInstanceMS и не подходят для blocking work.

action_detail.en: Prefer handles for delayed or blocking work; use instance snapshots only for immediate non-blocking operations.
action_detail.fr: Préférez les handles pour le travail différé ou bloquant ; utilisez les instances uniquement pour une opération immédiate non bloquante.
action_detail.zh: 延迟或阻塞工作应优先使用 handle；instance 快照仅用于立即完成的非阻塞操作。
action_detail.ru: Для delayed/blocking work используйте handles; instance snapshots — только для немедленных non-blocking операций.

headline.en: AVX-512 availability is computed once during CPU startup detection
headline.fr: La disponibilité AVX-512 est calculée une fois au démarrage
headline.zh: AVX-512 可用性在 CPU 启动检测时一次计算
headline.ru: Доступность AVX-512 вычисляется один раз при startup CPU detection

what_changed.en: The public no-argument IntelAvx512 function becomes a TIntelCpuFeatures global populated by TestCpuFeatures, avoiding repeated XGETBV calls while retaining the XCR0 filter.
what_changed.fr: La fonction publique IntelAvx512 sans argument devient un global TIntelCpuFeatures rempli par TestCpuFeatures, évitant les appels XGETBV répétés tout en gardant le filtre XCR0.
what_changed.zh: 公开无参数函数 IntelAvx512 改为由 TestCpuFeatures 填充的 TIntelCpuFeatures global，避免重复 XGETBV，同时保留 XCR0 过滤。
what_changed.ru: Public no-argument функция IntelAvx512 стала global TIntelCpuFeatures, заполняемым TestCpuFeatures, что убирает повторные XGETBV при сохранении XCR0 filter.

impact.en: Feature checks become a variable read. Ordinary Pascal expressions using IntelAvx512 remain natural, but code explicitly taking the function address must change.
impact.fr: Les checks deviennent une lecture de variable. Les expressions Pascal restent naturelles, mais le code prenant explicitement l’adresse de la fonction doit changer.
impact.zh: 特性检查变为读取变量；普通 Pascal 表达式仍可自然使用 IntelAvx512，但显式获取函数地址的代码必须修改。
impact.ru: Feature check стал чтением variable. Обычные Pascal expressions остаются естественными, но код, берущий адрес функции, должен измениться.

action_detail.en: Search only low-level code that stores or passes the IntelAvx512 function pointer; normal value checks need no migration.
action_detail.fr: Recherchez seulement le code bas niveau qui stocke ou passe le pointeur de fonction IntelAvx512 ; les checks de valeur ne changent pas.
action_detail.zh: 仅检查存储或传递 IntelAvx512 函数指针的低层代码；普通值检查无需迁移。
action_detail.ru: Ищите только low-level code, сохраняющий или передающий function pointer IntelAvx512; обычные value checks не требуют migration.

note.en: The same-edition function is finalized as a precomputed global variable.
note.fr: La fonction introduite dans la même édition devient une variable globale précalculée.
note.zh: 同一期引入的函数最终改为预计算 global 变量。
note.ru: Функция этого же выпуска финализирована как precomputed global variable.

headline.en: Delphi exception interception is guarded by actual RTL availability
headline.fr: L’interception Delphi est conditionnée par la disponibilité réelle du RTL
headline.zh: Delphi 异常拦截按 RTL 实际可用性启用
headline.ru: Delphi exception interception включается по реальной доступности RTL

what_changed.en: The POSIX include defines WITH_RAISEEXCEPTOBJPROC only when HASRAISEEXCEPTOBJPROC is available; the remaining changes clarify stack filtering and comments.
what_changed.fr: L’include POSIX ne définit WITH_RAISEEXCEPTOBJPROC que si HASRAISEEXCEPTOBJPROC est disponible ; les autres changements clarifient les filtres de stack et commentaires.
what_changed.zh: POSIX include 仅在 HASRAISEEXCEPTOBJPROC 可用时定义 WITH_RAISEEXCEPTOBJPROC；其余修改澄清 stack filter 与注释。
what_changed.ru: POSIX include задаёт WITH_RAISEEXCEPTOBJPROC только при HASRAISEEXCEPTOBJPROC; остальные изменения уточняют stack filtering и comments.

impact.en: Older Delphi targets avoid compiling against an unavailable interception hook. FPC and supported modern Delphi behavior is unchanged.
impact.fr: Les anciennes cibles Delphi évitent de compiler contre un hook indisponible. Le comportement FPC et Delphi moderne reste inchangé.
impact.zh: 旧 Delphi 目标不会编译不存在的拦截 hook；FPC 与受支持现代 Delphi 行为不变。
impact.ru: Старые Delphi targets не компилируются с недоступным interception hook. Поведение FPC и modern Delphi не меняется.

headline.en: Delphi POSIX gains preliminary automatic exception logging
headline.fr: Delphi POSIX gagne un logging automatique préliminaire des exceptions
headline.zh: Delphi POSIX 新增初步自动异常日志
headline.ru: Delphi POSIX получил предварительное автоматическое логирование исключений

what_changed.en: mormot.defines.inc enables exception interception on Delphi POSIX, and mormot.core.os.posix selects RaiseExceptObjProc instead of the FPC RaiseProc hook.
what_changed.fr: mormot.defines.inc active l’interception sous Delphi POSIX et mormot.core.os.posix sélectionne RaiseExceptObjProc au lieu du hook FPC RaiseProc.
what_changed.zh: mormot.defines.inc 在 Delphi POSIX 启用异常拦截，mormot.core.os.posix 选择 RaiseExceptObjProc 而不是 FPC 的 RaiseProc hook。
what_changed.ru: mormot.defines.inc включает interception на Delphi POSIX, а mormot.core.os.posix выбирает RaiseExceptObjProc вместо FPC RaiseProc hook.

impact.en: Delphi Linux and mobile-style POSIX builds can emit automatic TSynLog exception records where they previously had no interceptor. FPC behavior is unchanged.
impact.fr: Les builds Delphi Linux et POSIX mobile peuvent produire des records TSynLog automatiques là où aucun intercepteur n’existait. FPC ne change pas.
impact.zh: Delphi Linux 与移动 POSIX 构建现在可自动输出 TSynLog 异常记录，此前没有 interceptor；FPC 行为不变。
impact.ru: Delphi Linux и mobile POSIX builds могут автоматически писать TSynLog exception records там, где interceptor отсутствовал. FPC не меняется.

action_detail.en: Check log volume and exception stack formatting on each Delphi POSIX target before production rollout.
action_detail.fr: Vérifiez le volume des logs et le format des stacks sur chaque cible Delphi POSIX avant production.
action_detail.zh: 上线前在每个 Delphi POSIX 目标检查日志量与异常 stack 格式。
action_detail.ru: Перед production проверьте объём logs и формат exception stack на каждом Delphi POSIX target.

headline.en: Modern Delphi uses one exception hook without duplicate records
headline.fr: Delphi moderne utilise un seul hook sans records d’exception dupliqués
headline.zh: 现代 Delphi 使用单一异常 hook，避免重复记录
headline.ru: Современный Delphi использует один exception hook без дублей

what_changed.en: SynRaiseProc is generalized for RaiseExceptObjProc, Windows vectored and unwind handlers skip Delphi exceptions already handled by that hook, fake RTL exception codes are filtered, and original handlers remain chained.
what_changed.fr: SynRaiseProc est généralisé pour RaiseExceptObjProc, les handlers Windows ignorent les exceptions Delphi déjà traitées, les faux codes RTL sont filtrés et les handlers d’origine restent chaînés.
what_changed.zh: SynRaiseProc 泛化以支持 RaiseExceptObjProc；Windows vectored 与 unwind handler 跳过已处理的 Delphi 异常，过滤伪 RTL 异常码，并保留原 handler 链。
what_changed.ru: SynRaiseProc обобщён для RaiseExceptObjProc; Windows vectored/unwind handlers пропускают уже обработанные Delphi exceptions, фильтруют fake RTL codes и сохраняют цепочку original handlers.

impact.en: Delphi exception logs are emitted once while third-party and RTL hooks keep running. Windows and POSIX routing is more consistent.
impact.fr: Les exceptions Delphi sont loguées une seule fois tout en conservant les hooks RTL et tiers. Le routage Windows/POSIX devient cohérent.
impact.zh: Delphi 异常只记录一次，同时第三方与 RTL hook 继续运行；Windows 与 POSIX 路由更一致。
impact.ru: Delphi exceptions логируются один раз при сохранении RTL и third-party hooks. Routing Windows/POSIX стал согласованнее.

action_detail.en: Upgrade if TSynLog exception interception is enabled, then compare single-thread and multi-thread exception counts.
action_detail.fr: Mettez à niveau si l’interception TSynLog est active, puis comparez les compteurs mono-thread et multi-thread.
action_detail.zh: 若启用 TSynLog 异常拦截，请升级并比较单线程与多线程异常计数。
action_detail.ru: Обновитесь при включённом TSynLog interception и сравните single-thread/multi-thread exception counts.

headline.en: Exception logs tolerate an unknown instruction address
headline.fr: Les logs d’exception tolèrent une adresse d’instruction inconnue
headline.zh: 异常日志可处理未知指令地址
headline.ru: Exception logs допускают неизвестный instruction address

what_changed.en: SynLogException omits the 'at' pointer field when TSynLogExceptionContext.EAddr is zero, using safe writer calls before appending any available stack frames.
what_changed.fr: SynLogException omet le champ pointeur 'at' lorsque TSynLogExceptionContext.EAddr vaut zéro et utilise des writes sûrs avant les frames disponibles.
what_changed.zh: 当 TSynLogExceptionContext.EAddr 为零时，SynLogException 省略“at”指针字段，并在追加可用 stack frame 前使用安全 writer 调用。
what_changed.ru: SynLogException не выводит поле 'at', если TSynLogExceptionContext.EAddr равен нулю, и использует безопасные writer calls перед доступными stack frames.

impact.en: Delphi LLVM exception records with no reliable address remain well-formed and retain their available stack trace.
impact.fr: Les records d’exception Delphi LLVM sans adresse fiable restent bien formés et conservent la stack disponible.
impact.zh: 没有可靠地址的 Delphi LLVM 异常记录仍保持正确格式，并保留可用 stack trace。
impact.ru: Delphi LLVM exception records без надёжного адреса остаются корректными и сохраняют доступный stack trace.

headline.en: Concurrent exceptions no longer disappear from TSynLog
headline.fr: Les exceptions concurrentes ne disparaissent plus de TSynLog
headline.zh: 并发异常不再从 TSynLog 中消失
headline.ru: Concurrent exceptions больше не исчезают из TSynLog

what_changed.en: Exception handlers stop clearing the global _RawLogException callback around each log operation. Recursion remains suppressed per thread through PerThreadInfo.ExceptionIgnore, so other threads keep their handler active.
what_changed.fr: Les handlers cessent de mettre le callback global _RawLogException à nil pendant chaque log. La récursion reste bloquée par thread via PerThreadInfo.ExceptionIgnore, donc les autres threads conservent leur handler.
what_changed.zh: 异常 handler 不再在每次日志操作时清空全局 _RawLogException callback；递归仍由每线程 PerThreadInfo.ExceptionIgnore 抑制，因此其他线程的 handler 保持有效。
what_changed.ru: Exception handlers больше не очищают global _RawLogException при каждом log. Recursion подавляется per-thread через PerThreadInfo.ExceptionIgnore, поэтому handler других потоков остаётся активным.

impact.en: Exceptions raised simultaneously on different threads are no longer silently omitted from logs. Delphi and FPC services with concurrent workloads are affected.
impact.fr: Les exceptions levées simultanément sur plusieurs threads ne sont plus omises silencieusement. Les services Delphi/FPC concurrents sont concernés.
impact.zh: 不同线程同时抛出的异常不再静默漏记；并发 Delphi/FPC 服务均受影响。
impact.ru: Исключения, одновременно поднятые в разных потоках, больше не пропускаются. Затронуты concurrent Delphi/FPC services.

action_detail.en: Generate simultaneous handled exceptions on worker threads and verify that each appears exactly once in TSynLog.
action_detail.fr: Générez des exceptions traitées simultanées sur des workers et vérifiez que chacune apparaît exactement une fois dans TSynLog.
action_detail.zh: 在 worker 线程同时产生已处理异常，并确认每个异常在 TSynLog 中恰好出现一次。
action_detail.ru: Создайте одновременные handled exceptions в worker threads и убедитесь, что каждая появляется в TSynLog ровно один раз.

headline.en: Delphi Win32 exceptions stop being logged twice
headline.fr: Les exceptions Delphi Win32 ne sont plus loguées deux fois
headline.zh: Delphi Win32 异常不再重复记录
headline.ru: Исключения Delphi Win32 больше не логируются дважды

what_changed.en: Delphi 2009+ Win32 installs RaiseExceptObjProc for language exceptions and makes RTLUnwindProc skip cRtlException records already handled by the cleaner hook.
what_changed.fr: Delphi 2009+ Win32 installe RaiseExceptObjProc pour les exceptions du langage et fait ignorer par RTLUnwindProc les records cRtlException déjà traités.
what_changed.zh: Delphi 2009+ Win32 使用 RaiseExceptObjProc 处理语言异常，并让 RTLUnwindProc 跳过已由该 hook 处理的 cRtlException 记录。
what_changed.ru: Delphi 2009+ Win32 устанавливает RaiseExceptObjProc для language exceptions, а RTLUnwindProc пропускает уже обработанные cRtlException records.

impact.en: TSynLog no longer emits duplicate records for ordinary Delphi Win32 exceptions; older Delphi and FPC retain their existing hooks.
impact.fr: TSynLog n’émet plus de doublons pour les exceptions Delphi Win32 ordinaires ; les anciens Delphi et FPC gardent leurs hooks.
impact.zh: TSynLog 不再为普通 Delphi Win32 异常输出重复记录；旧 Delphi 与 FPC 保持原有 hook。
impact.ru: TSynLog больше не пишет дубли для обычных Delphi Win32 exceptions; старые Delphi и FPC сохраняют свои hooks.

action_detail.en: Compare Win32 exception log counts before and after upgrading if alerts depend on one record per exception.
action_detail.fr: Comparez les compteurs Win32 avant et après mise à niveau si les alertes supposent un record par exception.
action_detail.zh: 若告警依赖每个异常一条记录，请比较升级前后的 Win32 异常日志计数。
action_detail.ru: Сравните Win32 exception log counts до и после обновления, если alerts ожидают одну запись на exception.

headline.en: A reset-peer regression test reproduces the WebSocket broadcast deadlock
headline.fr: Un test avec peer reset reproduit le deadlock de broadcast WebSocket
headline.zh: 新增 reset peer 测试复现 WebSocket 广播死锁
headline.ru: Regression test с reset peer воспроизводит WebSocket broadcast deadlock

what_changed.en: TNetworkProtocols adds a server, broadcast worker and 50 short-lived clients that close with unread frames and RST; failure to accept the next client exposes a wedged server.
what_changed.fr: TNetworkProtocols ajoute un serveur, un worker de broadcast et 50 clients éphémères fermant avec frames non lues et RST ; l’échec de la connexion suivante révèle le blocage.
what_changed.zh: TNetworkProtocols 新增服务器、广播 worker 与 50 个短连接客户端；客户端带未读 frame 以 RST 关闭，若下一个连接无法接受即可暴露服务器卡死。
what_changed.ru: TNetworkProtocols добавляет server, broadcast worker и 50 short-lived clients, закрывающихся с unread frames и RST; невозможность принять следующий client выявляет wedged server.

impact.en: The test captures issue #629 without changing production behavior.
impact.fr: Le test capture l’issue #629 sans changer le comportement de production.
impact.zh: 该测试覆盖 issue #629，不改变生产行为。
impact.ru: Тест покрывает issue #629 без изменения production behavior.

headline.en: RTSP-over-HTTP forwarding no longer writes under ConnectionLock
headline.fr: Le forwarding RTSP-over-HTTP n’écrit plus sous ConnectionLock
headline.zh: RTSP-over-HTTP 转发不再在 ConnectionLock 下写入
headline.ru: RTSP-over-HTTP forwarding больше не пишет под ConnectionLock

what_changed.en: TPostConnection.OnRead replaces ConnectionFindAndLock(cReadOnly) with ConnectionFind before WriteString, because a failed write may call ConnectionDelete and require the same lock in write mode.
what_changed.fr: TPostConnection.OnRead remplace ConnectionFindAndLock(cReadOnly) par ConnectionFind avant WriteString, car un échec d’écriture peut appeler ConnectionDelete et demander le même lock en écriture.
what_changed.zh: TPostConnection.OnRead 在 WriteString 前用 ConnectionFind 替代 ConnectionFindAndLock(cReadOnly)，因为写入失败可能调用 ConnectionDelete 并请求同一锁的 write mode。
what_changed.ru: TPostConnection.OnRead заменяет ConnectionFindAndLock(cReadOnly) на ConnectionFind перед WriteString, поскольку failed write может вызвать ConnectionDelete и запросить тот же lock в write mode.

impact.en: RTSP-over-HTTP POST forwarding no longer self-deadlocks when the paired RTSP connection disappears during a write.
impact.fr: Le forwarding POST RTSP-over-HTTP ne se deadlocke plus si la connexion RTSP associée disparaît pendant l’écriture.
impact.zh: 配对 RTSP 连接在写入期间消失时，RTSP-over-HTTP POST 转发不再自锁。
impact.ru: RTSP-over-HTTP POST forwarding больше не deadlock, если связанное RTSP connection исчезает во время write.

action_detail.en: Stress RTSP-over-HTTP clients that disconnect while POST commands are being forwarded.
action_detail.fr: Stressez des clients RTSP-over-HTTP qui se déconnectent pendant le forwarding des commandes POST.
action_detail.zh: 压力测试在 POST 命令转发期间断开的 RTSP-over-HTTP 客户端。
action_detail.ru: Нагрузочно проверьте RTSP-over-HTTP clients, отключающиеся во время forwarding POST commands.

headline.en: WebSocket broadcast sends leave the connection read lock before writing
headline.fr: Le broadcast WebSocket libère le read lock avant d’écrire
headline.zh: WebSocket 广播在写入前释放连接 read lock
headline.ru: WebSocket broadcast освобождает connection read lock до записи

what_changed.en: WebSocketBroadcast copies destination handles while holding ConnectionLock.ReadOnlyLock, releases it, then encodes and sends frames via ConnectionFind. Documentation warns that Write may call ConnectionDelete and must not run under a read lock.
what_changed.fr: WebSocketBroadcast copie les handles sous ConnectionLock.ReadOnlyLock, le libère puis encode et envoie via ConnectionFind. La documentation avertit que Write peut appeler ConnectionDelete et ne doit pas tourner sous read lock.
what_changed.zh: WebSocketBroadcast 在 ConnectionLock.ReadOnlyLock 下复制目标 handle，释放锁后再编码并通过 ConnectionFind 发送；文档明确 Write 可能调用 ConnectionDelete，不得在 read lock 下执行。
what_changed.ru: WebSocketBroadcast копирует destination handles под ConnectionLock.ReadOnlyLock, освобождает его, затем кодирует и отправляет через ConnectionFind. Документация предупреждает, что Write может вызвать ConnectionDelete и не должен выполняться под read lock.

impact.en: A failed broadcast send can delete its connection without trying to upgrade a read lock and deadlocking the async server. Later commits complete nil and lifetime handling.
impact.fr: Un send de broadcast défaillant peut supprimer sa connexion sans tenter d’upgrader un read lock et bloquer le serveur. Les commits suivants finalisent nil et lifetime.
impact.zh: 广播 send 失败后可删除连接，不再尝试升级 read lock 而死锁 async 服务器；后续提交完善 nil 与生命周期处理。
impact.ru: Failed broadcast send может удалить connection без upgrade read lock и deadlock async server. Поздние commits завершают nil/lifetime handling.

headline.en: WebSocket clients and local tunnels publish shutdown state safely
headline.fr: Les clients WebSocket et tunnels locaux publient sûrement leur état de shutdown
headline.zh: WebSocket 客户端与本地 tunnel 安全发布 shutdown 状态
headline.ru: WebSocket clients и local tunnels безопасно публикуют shutdown state

what_changed.en: TTunnelLocal.ClosePort sets fClosed while fSendSafe is still locked, THttpClientWebSockets.Destroy uses FreeAndNilSafe, and callback requests use fProtocol.ConnectionFlags rather than reaching through the owner thread.
what_changed.fr: TTunnelLocal.ClosePort définit fClosed tant que fSendSafe est verrouillé, THttpClientWebSockets.Destroy utilise FreeAndNilSafe et les callbacks prennent fProtocol.ConnectionFlags directement.
what_changed.zh: TTunnelLocal.ClosePort 在 fSendSafe 仍锁定时设置 fClosed；THttpClientWebSockets.Destroy 改用 FreeAndNilSafe；callback 请求直接使用 fProtocol.ConnectionFlags。
what_changed.ru: TTunnelLocal.ClosePort ставит fClosed под fSendSafe, THttpClientWebSockets.Destroy использует FreeAndNilSafe, а callback requests берут fProtocol.ConnectionFlags напрямую.

impact.en: Tunnel senders and WaitForHandshake observers see closure in a consistent order, and WebSocket client destruction is safer under concurrent callbacks.
impact.fr: Les senders du tunnel et observers WaitForHandshake voient la fermeture dans un ordre cohérent, et la destruction du client WebSocket est plus sûre sous callbacks concurrents.
impact.zh: Tunnel sender 与 WaitForHandshake observer 以一致顺序看到关闭；并发 callback 下 WebSocket 客户端析构更安全。
impact.ru: Tunnel senders и WaitForHandshake observers видят closure в согласованном порядке, а уничтожение WebSocket client безопаснее при concurrent callbacks.

action_detail.en: Test ClosePort while a thread is in WaitForHandshake and destroy WebSocket clients while callbacks are active.
action_detail.fr: Testez ClosePort pendant WaitForHandshake et détruisez les clients WebSocket pendant des callbacks actifs.
action_detail.zh: 测试线程处于 WaitForHandshake 时调用 ClosePort，以及 callback 活动期间销毁 WebSocket 客户端。
action_detail.ru: Проверьте ClosePort во время WaitForHandshake и уничтожение WebSocket clients при активных callbacks.

headline.en: TTunnelLocal marks closure before waking handshake waiters
headline.fr: TTunnelLocal marque la fermeture avant de réveiller WaitForHandshake
headline.zh: TTunnelLocal 在唤醒 handshake waiter 前标记关闭
headline.ru: TTunnelLocal отмечает closure до пробуждения handshake waiters

what_changed.en: TTunnelLocal.ClosePort and the remote-close frame path set fClosed before signaling fHandshakeEvent, so WaitForHandshake cannot wake and observe the previous open state.
what_changed.fr: TTunnelLocal.ClosePort et le chemin remote-close définissent fClosed avant de signaler fHandshakeEvent, empêchant WaitForHandshake de voir l’ancien état ouvert.
what_changed.zh: TTunnelLocal.ClosePort 与 remote-close frame 路径在触发 fHandshakeEvent 前设置 fClosed，避免 WaitForHandshake 醒来后仍看到旧 open 状态。
what_changed.ru: TTunnelLocal.ClosePort и remote-close path ставят fClosed до сигнала fHandshakeEvent, чтобы WaitForHandshake не увидел прежнее open state.

impact.en: Handshake waiters receive a consistent closed state. The following commit moves the assignment inside the send lock to complete synchronization.
impact.fr: Les waiters voient un état closed cohérent. Le commit suivant déplace l’affectation sous le send lock pour finaliser la synchronisation.
impact.zh: Handshake waiter 会看到一致的 closed 状态；下一提交把赋值移入 send lock 完成同步。
impact.ru: Handshake waiters получают согласованный closed state. Следующий commit переносит assignment внутрь send lock для полной синхронизации.

headline.en: mTLS test workers catch and classify network exceptions reliably
headline.fr: Les workers de test mTLS capturent correctement les exceptions réseau
headline.zh: mTLS 测试 worker 可靠捕获并分类网络异常
headline.ru: mTLS test workers надёжно ловят и классифицируют network exceptions

what_changed.en: The SChannel/OpenSSL test runner wraps each worker execution, logs the raised class, accepts ENetSock as the expected network failure and gives each async server a distinct logged process name.
what_changed.fr: Le runner SChannel/OpenSSL enveloppe chaque worker, logue la classe levée, accepte ENetSock comme échec réseau attendu et donne un nom distinct à chaque serveur async.
what_changed.zh: SChannel/OpenSSL 测试 runner 包裹每个 worker 执行，记录异常类，把 ENetSock 视为预期网络失败，并给每个 async 服务器设置独立日志名称。
what_changed.ru: SChannel/OpenSSL test runner оборачивает worker execution, логирует класс exception, принимает ENetSock как ожидаемый network failure и задаёт каждому async server отдельное имя.

impact.en: TLS regression failures become diagnosable without changing application runtime behavior.
impact.fr: Les échecs de régression TLS deviennent diagnosticables sans changer le comportement runtime applicatif.
impact.zh: TLS 回归失败更易诊断，不改变应用运行时行为。
impact.ru: TLS regression failures легче диагностировать без изменения application runtime behavior.

headline.en: Default RSA generation timeouts scale with key size
headline.fr: Les timeouts RSA par défaut évoluent avec la taille de clé
headline.zh: 默认 RSA 生成 timeout 随密钥长度扩展
headline.ru: Default RSA generation timeout масштабируется с размером ключа

what_changed.en: TRsa.Generate multiplies RSA_DEFAULT_GENERATION_TIMEOUTMS by 4 for 3072-bit keys, 16 for 4096-bit keys and 64 for 7680/8192-bit keys, while preserving explicit custom timeouts.
what_changed.fr: TRsa.Generate multiplie RSA_DEFAULT_GENERATION_TIMEOUTMS par 4 pour 3072 bits, 16 pour 4096 bits et 64 pour 7680/8192 bits, sans modifier les timeouts explicites.
what_changed.zh: TRsa.Generate 对 3072-bit 密钥将 RSA_DEFAULT_GENERATION_TIMEOUTMS 乘 4，4096-bit 乘 16，7680/8192-bit 乘 64，同时保留显式自定义 timeout。
what_changed.ru: TRsa.Generate умножает RSA_DEFAULT_GENERATION_TIMEOUTMS на 4 для 3072-bit, на 16 для 4096-bit и на 64 для 7680/8192-bit keys, сохраняя explicit custom timeouts.

impact.en: Weak CPUs are less likely to report rgrTimeout when generating large RSA keys with defaults. Callers supplying their own TimeOutMS keep the same limit.
impact.fr: Les CPU faibles risquent moins de renvoyer rgrTimeout pour de grandes clés avec les défauts. Les TimeOutMS explicites restent inchangés.
impact.zh: 弱 CPU 使用默认值生成大型 RSA 密钥时更不易返回 rgrTimeout；显式提供 TimeOutMS 的调用保持原限制。
impact.ru: Слабые CPU реже возвращают rgrTimeout при generation больших RSA keys с defaults. Явный TimeOutMS не меняется.

action_detail.en: Review latency budgets for 3072-bit and larger key generation; set TimeOutMS explicitly if the longer default is unsuitable.
action_detail.fr: Revoyez les budgets de latence pour 3072 bits et plus ; fixez TimeOutMS explicitement si le nouveau défaut est trop long.
action_detail.zh: 审查 3072-bit 及以上密钥生成的延迟预算；若更长默认值不合适，请显式设置 TimeOutMS。
action_detail.ru: Проверьте latency budgets для 3072-bit+ generation; задайте TimeOutMS явно, если более долгий default не подходит.

headline.en: AVX-512 detection now verifies OS-managed ZMM state
headline.fr: La détection AVX-512 vérifie l’état ZMM géré par l’OS
headline.zh: AVX-512 检测现在验证 OS 管理的 ZMM 状态
headline.ru: AVX-512 detection проверяет управляемое OS состояние ZMM

what_changed.en: mormot.core.base adds IsZmmOSEnabled assembly, AVX-512 feature-set constants, IntelAvx512 filtering through XCR0 and cpuAVX512 in TX64CpuFeatures for the x86-64-v4 subset.
what_changed.fr: mormot.core.base ajoute l’assembleur IsZmmOSEnabled, des constantes de features AVX-512, le filtre IntelAvx512 via XCR0 et cpuAVX512 dans TX64CpuFeatures pour x86-64-v4.
what_changed.zh: mormot.core.base 新增 IsZmmOSEnabled 汇编、AVX-512 feature-set 常量、经 XCR0 过滤的 IntelAvx512，以及 TX64CpuFeatures 中标识 x86-64-v4 子集的 cpuAVX512。
what_changed.ru: mormot.core.base добавляет asm IsZmmOSEnabled, AVX-512 feature-set constants, фильтрацию IntelAvx512 через XCR0 и cpuAVX512 в TX64CpuFeatures для x86-64-v4.

impact.en: CPU dispatch can avoid AVX-512 instructions when CPUID advertises them but an old OS or VM does not preserve opmask and ZMM registers, preventing #UD faults.
impact.fr: Le dispatch peut éviter AVX-512 lorsque CPUID l’annonce mais qu’un ancien OS ou une VM ne sauvegarde pas opmask/ZMM, empêchant les fautes #UD.
impact.zh: 当 CPUID 宣告 AVX-512 但旧 OS 或 VM 不保存 opmask/ZMM 寄存器时，CPU 调度可避开 AVX-512 指令，防止 #UD fault。
impact.ru: CPU dispatch может не использовать AVX-512, если CPUID его сообщает, но старый OS/VM не сохраняет opmask/ZMM, предотвращая #UD faults.

action_detail.en: Use IntelAvx512 or cpuAVX512 rather than raw CpuFeatures before custom EVEX dispatch, especially inside VMs.
action_detail.fr: Utilisez IntelAvx512 ou cpuAVX512 plutôt que CpuFeatures brut avant un dispatch EVEX personnalisé, surtout en VM.
action_detail.zh: 自定义 EVEX 调度前应使用 IntelAvx512 或 cpuAVX512，而不是原始 CpuFeatures，尤其在 VM 中。
action_detail.ru: Перед custom EVEX dispatch используйте IntelAvx512 или cpuAVX512 вместо raw CpuFeatures, особенно в VM.
